title: Spinner
summary: Indeterminate progress for a short wait, such as a button or a line of status. Prefer Skeleton when content is loading and Progress when the amount is known.

demos.title: Sizes
demos.note: Sized with a size class; the default is 16px, to sit in a line of text or a button.

demos.title: With words
demos.note: Its accessible name is "Loading" unless you pass label. When visible text already says what is happening, pass an empty label so it is not announced twice. Press the button.
